summary: Pruned 16 finished rows (everything ended by Sun 12 Jul incl. Kingston Regatta, Eel Pie Open Studios, Henry VIII Joust, As You Like It, Canbury Soul Rites, Matilda JR). Added 67 dated events + 3 recurring rows, dominated by this run's discovery theme: FOLK/THEATRE VENUES ONE STOP FURTHER OUT, cracked via two never-tried angles. (1) Spektrix API probe - system.spektrix.com/<client>/api/v3/events is public JSON for both the Orange Tree (client: orangetree) and the Rose (rosetheatrekingston); with the Orange Tree site itself yielded 5 Richmond rows (outdoor Shakespeare in rep on Richmond Hill 31 Jul-22 Aug, Murder in the Cathedral church staging, Sunday coffee concert) and 7 Exchange Twickenham rows (Fairport Convention 25 Oct, Joni Mitchell tribute, Comedy Club 4 Kids, half-term Mr Sleepybum, Cinderella panto 7-27 Dec). (2) Folk-scene sweep - TwickFolk (Cabbage Patch) publishes a full dated autumn diary with prices: 12 rows (Nancy Kerr & James Fagan, Kathryn Roberts & Sean Lakeman, Jack Rutter, Jackie Oates & John Spiers Christmas special); EFDSS/Cecil Sharp House embeds its whole season as JSON in the page: 15 destination folk rows (Le Vent du Nord, Leveret, Furrow Collective, The Young'uns, family barn dances, NYE ceilidh) + 2 recurring (monthly barndance + ceilidh) + a new fortnightly Poyntz Arms East Molesey Irish session (recurring, verify). Also: 6 new Landmark autumn/winter shows via its Ticketsolve XML (Susan Santos, Dom Martin, R.U.M, Beer Festival), 11 new OSO Barnes rows (Comedy Store x2, 6 community theatre runs, 18+ panto), 3 Banquet church/venue one-offs (Roger Taylor x Paul Whitehouse, Melanie C, Dan Croll), 4 library summer one-offs and 4 free PlayZone launch sessions. CONFIRMATIONS: 8 Landmark rows got exact times/prices (verify cleared) and 12 OSO rows got prices from per-event Ticketsolve feeds; Claremont 1 Aug Saturday Session performer named (The Dixieland Stompers, trad jazz); Woody Guthrie show start corrected to 19:45; Will James at ExCellar 26 Nov re-confirmed (watchlist item resolved). CAUTION: Stewart Lee 7-8 Sep Rose page has been DELISTED (404, gone from sitemap, not on stewartlee.co.uk) - likely sold out; row kept with verify:true and a re-check note. Still unpublished, honestly held on watchlist: Playday 2026, Kingston Carnival 2026, River Cultures 2026, HCP Halloween half-term, Raise The Bar headliner, Speakeasy Brunch acts, Landmark Christmas fair, Orange Tree Christmas show. Dedupe prevented 30+ duplicates (most Ram Jam/ExCellar/library/Claremont/Bach-to-Baby agent finds were already held from the 7 and 10 Jul runs).
